runs.note: NEAT from a cloned teacher network (24 hidden), six stages: calm, steady push, gusts, turbulence, boulder, polish. Training wheels fade in stages 2-4.

Attempt B = A with two fixes: the steady push now follows the wind ramp (in A it was always full strength), and training wheels start at 0.3, not 1.0 (the pilot landed 83% with full wheels, 84% without, 89.5% at 0.3). Steady-push pass lowered to 90%: a constant push up to 15 is harder than real gusts (the pilot: 84%).

Attempt C = B resumed from its population at gen ~412 (in the gusts + turbulence stage), with one change: the boulder stage ramps the boulder size from 40% to 100%. Why: the cloned start network only landed 25% with the boulder (pilot 77%) and B's best wind champion 14% (300 paired flights): the boulder skill was never cloned well, so it must be learned in NEAT, from small boulders up.
